Original RCA (per founder's own live DB inspection): PATCH /cto/projects/{id} updated auth_method='github_app' and installation_id but never called the same verify+set-installation_active path add_project used, so reconnects landed the doc in state {auth_method:'github_app', installation_id:<real>, installation_active:undef} — PatRequiredCTA gates on installation_active===true, so banner never cleared.
